user.title: Xparkle RV level
user.description: Enter the sensor Bluetooth address and exact name observed by Home Assistant. Setup does not connect. Close the phone app before starting measurement.

error.invalid_target: Check the address and supported RVLevel/RVbalance name.

cleanup_pending.message: The connection is in use, closing, or cleanup is unconfirmed. Check session status before starting again.

session_inactive.message: Start measurement first. An expired session is not restarted automatically.

init.title: Measurement, dimensions and mounting
init.description: Measurement ends after10 minutes without explicit renewal. Read interval targets start-to-start cadence (0.1–10s); slow replies can extend it. Tolerance/illustration-only changes neither stop nor renew measurement. Other settings stop it without restarting. Battery refresh is0(disabled) or1–168hours. Dimensions are reference-point distances along the rigid body; corrections are estimates. Mounting location neither modifies device settings nor rotates reported angles. Save a new location first, then separately confirm current output directions. Home Assistant selects the Bluetooth adapter automatically.

data.directions_confirmed: Current directions confirmed for this mounting

data_description.vehicle_width_cm: Measure between the left/right calculation reference points along the body, not automatically overall width or wheel track.
data_description.vehicle_length_cm: Measure between the front/rear calculation reference points. To estimate jockey-wheel movement around an axle, use axle-to-jockey span and interpret the front figure at that support; rear is the alternative reference, not a second simultaneous move.
data_description.directions_confirmed: Confirm only when the Uphill flag being on currently means front high and the Left tilt flag being on means left low in your mounting. This is local interpretation, not calibration or hardware validation.

error.invalid_options: Use valid measurement settings and finite spans: width 1–500cm, length 1–2000cm; 0 leaves a span unset. Confirm directions only with both spans and a selected mounting.
